events.title: Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello to anyone reading this. The store page has been updated with an official trailer and new art! I have been preparing for Steam Next Fest for quite some time now. For those who don't know, three times a year steam holds a Next Fest for mostly indie games. Any eligible game can sign up, but the catch is that you can only sign up once per game and never more no matter how many years pass. So this means this is my one and only shot at Next Fest. There will be no more updates for the demo after this (unless something soft-locks players). Everything I want to showcase is in here worth around 2 hours of gameplay. The demo holds about 20% of the full game, so this is quite an overkill. However, behind the scenes, it was mostly me establishing systems that I can maintain and streamline to the finish goal.
